why: Moot and accepted dispositions are judgement calls that remove a defect from the acceptance bar; only the owner may close them, and argo cutover waits on this verdict.
what: The owner's sign-off file for every `moot` and `accepted` row of the argo friction disposition.
must_not_touch: docs/v3/acceptance/** (change a disposition only by reopening its ledger Issue)
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md section 6.5: `moot` needs the deleted subject named; `accepted` needs the owner's or the contract's reason. Input: the four files in docs/v3/acceptance/argo-friction-disposition/ (v3-argo-ledger, -ac, -v, -dt).
exemplar: Any earlier owner verdict file under docs/v3/verdicts/ (v3-verdict-statcard) for the table shape.
change: Render one table row per moot or accepted ledger row: id, bucket, one-line subject or reason, evidence link (route, test or deleted file), and an owner verdict cell. The owner fills each cell (confirmed, reopened as carried, or reopened with a note). Reopened rows go back to v3-argo-ledger as carried rows with a test. Rule: none. Skill snippet: none.
commits: One docs: commit, empty scope, no attribution; docs/** changes are REVIEW.md `none`. Rebase-merge.
acceptance: `rg -c '^\| [0-9]+ ' docs/v3/verdicts/argo-ledger.md` equals the count of moot plus accepted rows over the four disposition files (`jq -s '[.[].rows[]|select(.disposition!="carried")]|length' docs/v3/acceptance/argo-friction-disposition/*.json`)
every row's verdict cell is `confirmed` or `reopened`, none empty, none filled by a worker
every `reopened` id has disposition `carried` with a test path in its disposition file afterwards (back through the matching ledger Issue)
out_of_scope: Carried rows, any code, deciding accepted rows on the owner's behalf.
